method.correlation: Spearman rank correlation of daily market-level factor level with forward HS300 return
method.regression: OLS slope on standardized ranks with Newey-West HAC standard errors
method.hac_lag: equal to return horizon (5 or 20) for overlapping forward returns
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across factors within each horizon
method.use: market-regime conditioner research only; not a stock cross-sectional alpha
